digitalOcean.embeddingJobSchedule: three calls over about ten minutes every fifteen minutes
digitalOcean.varianceExplanation: The 2026-07-25 redacted account readback is $113.75 month-to-date versus a $109.22 invoice preview, a named $4.53 cadence/account-wide variance. Preview and balance endpoints update on different cadences and cover the entire account, which hosts multiple apps. DigitalOcean exposes no per-app accrued-transfer or invoice-preview allocation, so Sploot's exact July line item is not inferable from this authority.

vercel.reconciliation: The misty-step Vercel scope contains no Sploot project: the web runtime migrated to DigitalOcean App Platform (ADR-009), so project-attributed Vercel platform usage is zero for this period. Vercel Blob remains the only Vercel surface in use and is billed account-wide.
vercel.blobAttribution: Vercel Blob remains account-wide and unattributed at store level.

telemetry.reconciliation: Canary reports 8,411 Sploot errors across 50 unique classes in the last 30 days, read from its aggregate query API; the most frequent class is EmbeddingAdmissionError. Canary is a self-hosted shared DigitalOcean component; this is event usage, not a separate vendor bill, so the model allocates fixed component cost instead of inventing a per-event price.
